title: 沙盒逃脱
style: Hyper-speed phonk with heist-chase bounce, skittering drum programming, chopped vocal shouts, siren sweeps, and hard sidechain pulses; verse rides tight Chinese bars with English licks, pre-chorus strips to a menacing whisper stack, chorus slams with gang chants and repeat-hook pressure, bridge breaks to half-time and phone-chatter snippets before the final sprint. Close-mic lead with doubled hook cries, ad-lib pings, reversed risers, and a dusty, punchy low-end mix., bounce, fake, rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Maths driver，delta alpha plan
我贴着墙走，像影子开关
3 Mirrors 闪，别回头看
Heres my boys，thrash this toy，快把门拆烂

Take the right lane，别踩空档
Hyper speed plane，冲破封锁线旁
police chatter 在耳边响
Sirens sound，Unit 336 追到走廊上

我不等天亮，我只等缺口
假装一场 break，换一条出口
a robin a robin，先飞出笼口
cash back drop，地上全是惊愕

[Pre-Chorus]
Math Driver，别停
I can，you got this
我们都信
脚步像刀，快到发硬

VDS Mansion 近了
门口风在抖
沙盒城市睁眼
但我们已经走

[Chorus]
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
ah robin for good!

chase and cage，free birds rock
a robin in the hood
but it’s for good!
Math Driver，we believe
hyperspeed，take the lead

[Verse 2]
Sand box city，眼里全是沙
where are my toys? 我早就不答
bored stare like we care
ground hog day，重复得像罚

sand box say，but i forget what 8 is for
Math driver! VDS Mansion! 开门别锁
No way back，我们只往前挪
escape this place，像把锁链割破

G4 hyperpeed，你 got this boy
Delta track，D J Zyn Rose，别问谁是谁
pedals everywhere，轮子咬着轨
我们在拐角加速，像命运来追

[Bridge]
Thrash this toy
catch that boy
phonky sneaky phonk
让灰尘起火

give them rage in our cage
但我们不回头
the dream done safe done sound
一口气冲过终点口

[Chorus]
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
a robin in the hood
ah robin for good!

chase and cage，free birds rock
a robin in the hood
but it’s for good!
Math Driver，we believe
hyperspeed，take the lead

[Outro]
V D S mansion，party for me
V D S mansion，party for me
我们出来了，门还在滴
a robin a robin，飞进新街区
